item.title: Entropy and symbolic extensions for amenable group actions
item.description: arXiv:2609.00001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study topological entropy and symbolic extensions for actions of countable amenable groups. Under an explicit hypothesis, we prove a variational principle for a pressure-type invariant.
item.dc:creator: Ada Author, Bernhard Researcher

item.title: Numerical bifurcations in a reaction diffusion equation
item.description: arXiv:2609.00002v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We numerically investigate bifurcations in a reaction diffusion equation arising in a biological model.
